_schema_notes: Each entry is one craftable item/kit. 'ingredients' lists material+amount where confirmed; 'null' amount means the item is known to require that material but exact quantity is not yet verified in this database -- fill in as sourced, don't guess. 'source' distinguishes vanilla from mod content so a guide generator can include/exclude mod items per the user's mod config. 'verified' is false until every ingredient has a non-null amount and a citation in 'notes'. This file is a seed, not a complete catalog -- populate incrementally, ideally citing a wiki page or in-game observation per entry.

steel_ingot_first_batch.notes: This isn't a fixed recipe -- Oxite/Volatiles are furnace FUEL (raise temperature), not a fixed ratio to Iron/Coal. The 150g Iron : 50g Coal (3:1) ratio and 1-2/2-4 ice quantities are the documented minimum to reach steel-smelting temperature (~2000K). Confirmed via Community Wiki Guide (Mining).

solder_ingot.notes: Ratio confirmed (equal parts Iron+Lead) but not an absolute gram value -- needs a target batch size decision before this can be a fixed recipe entry. Requires controlled low-temperature smelt, not just fuel amount.

portable_air_scrubber.notes: Power draw (20.5W/tick) and tank volume (250L) confirmed via Community Wiki Portable_Air_Scrubber page. Recipe/ingredients not yet sourced -- item box for build cost not fetched.
